page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword "Ex" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Surculus est pars, quæ ex Ramis simplex annuatim oritur: ex surculis autem flores & fructus pendent.Surculus,
Partes minus principales sunt Cortex & Folia.Planta partes mi-nus prin-cipales,
CORTEX est veluti tunica quædam, ex fibris contenta, qua plantæ obducun-tur: Hæc ubi tenuior fuerit, cutis; ubi crassior cortex dicitur.Cortex.
Folia quasi excrementa sunt planta-rum, & constant humore & fibris.Folia.
main_text.head: Caput XVIII. DE VARIIS PLANTARUM AFFECTIONIBUS.
main_text.p: Affectio plantarum seu stirpium est primi generis aut secundi.
Primi generis est tum Ortus & propagatio, tū Transmutatio, tūm corruptio seu Mors.
Ortus & propagatio plantarum est Naturalis aut Artificialis.Plantarum ortus.
Naturalis qua sponte & natura sua nascuntur ex semine aut manifesto, aut nobis obscuro.Naturalis

page.notes: The initial "A" is a woodcut letter, joined to "ffectio" as "Affectio". The reading "tum" with a tilde in "est tum Ortus" is doubtful; the tilde in "tū" and "tūm" is read from the scan. The catchword "Ex" is faint but visible. The marginal notes are italic and hyphenated across lines, as printed.
